svg.title: Three render paths
svg.desc: Three rows. Remotion: you write TSX and React, a browser draws every frame, you get a video. HyperFrames: you write an HTML page with GSAP, a browser draws every frame, you get a video. Kinetograph: you write TSX or an HTML page, a Rust compositor draws every frame on the GPU, you get a video, with no browser.
